firstAha: share of the leading province’s beds that sit in up to three districts with the most beds (never cutting a tie, never every district holding beds), the share of beds within 500 m of an operating rail station there against the rest of the province (rows with a point; both bases), and the district(s) with the most beds outside it; the same with records under the count measure; a selection without beds offers the record measure; computed per selection; the map opens in the 3D city preset with those districts focused automatically and the rest quiet
countingUnit: measure switch: beds the HCODE register reports (เตียง, default; a reported 0 is 0; unknown beds counted apart, never 0) or records (แห่ง); lab prices, accreditation and services shown per facility as published

focusAndQuiet.implementation: app.js focus modes (auto/explicit/none) and row scopes; map-layers.js filled/quiet/province feature-state; pins.js cue symbols vs grey context dots; massing.js quiet city tier vs rounded focus tier, see-through front buildings in the building view (setScene eye); venue-xray.js draws the building being looked at over everything else; stations.js quiet station rings and the selected station radius; camera.js presets and the building view (fitBuilding, twoPointBearing); provinces.js frames below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter

layoutContract.mobilePortrait: full map, five toolbar buttons in one row (วิธีใช้ and Product statement at the top of the sheet); one compact dock at the foot of the map — the Aha finding in two lines with its action, over one legend row (measure switch เตียง | สถานพยาบาล, level + zero swatch over the 41-sample ramp) — above the attribution while it is open, dropped to the tray once it folds (Hotel 0.3.5); zoom buttons off on touch phones; bottom sheet 56% of the screen with a sticky close, opening on the facility, building, station or area

mapContract.basemap: generated at runtime by js/shell/map-style.js on https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet with --basemap-* tokens
mapContract.choropleth: li.supply (beds) or count (records), all 41 samples by rank over the measured nonzero values; beneath the basemap’s first line layer; zoom 8–14.5 (8–12.5 in terrain mode, hard switch), the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4; EVID-05 measured / measured_zero (sample 0 + 2 px zero outline) / no_data (beds unknown: hatch)
mapContract.provinces: the same measure per province frame below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter, outlines to zoom 12, ink-chip labels to zoom 9, panel list
mapContract.symbols: focus rows with a production point as cue icons whose area grows with the reported beds (a reported 0 at the 3 px floor, hollow = unknown); context rows as grey circles by beds, ≤ 6 px radius; HTML pins from zoom 15.5; the pin label is facility name · beds; stations of CityMETER Transit as quiet clickable rings from zoom 10.5, names from 13.5
mapContract.buildings: per อปท. (Bangkok: เขต): CityMETER Building V4 where it holds ≥ 1.15 × the OSM buildings of the unit, else OSM (data/building-units/ of CityMETER · Hotel 0.3.6); OSM buildings mapped in parts kept; the attribution names CityMETER Building V4 while drawn
mapContract.buildingView: eye preset corner-on to the building on the least-occluded diagonal, zoom to fit the free part of the map on every way in (js/shell/camera.js#fitBuilding); a station frames its 500 m radius. Hotel 0.3.2 rule (owner 2026-11-02 “… ต้องแสดง 2-point perspective ของ 3d building mass ทุกกรณี”): every facility with a point opens it — the building its pin falls in, else the drawn building nearest the pin within 300 m (800 m after one widen) with the pin in the frame (legend “อาคารใกล้หมุด”); choosing a facility or a building switches the map to 3D
mapContract.breadcrumb: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › เขต/อำเภอ with production codes and /D/ deep links, ?d=hospital
mapContract.symbolSize: area ∝ reported beds (js/model.js#pinRadius), floor 3 px for a reported 0, hollow = unknown beds, quiet context ≤ 6 px radius
mapContract.labels: from zoom 12.5: ≤ 9 (phone 5) labels in the central ellipse ranked by the beds percentile + published accreditation; text only — group cue, short name (รพ. · รพ.สต. · ศบส.), bed pictogram + beds; hover card of icon chips (type, beds, affiliation, level, accreditation) (js/labels.js)
mapContract.terrain: terrain mode at hilly sites (zoom ≥ 12.5, 3D, relief ≥ 30 m in view) and round a building or facility being looked at: 3D ground × 1.5 + hillshade in basemap tones; the district fill switches off at 12.5; buildings, the x-ray and the building camera stand on the drawn ground (js/shell/terrain.js, js/shell/camera.js); no terrain facts in the panels
mapContract.iconFirstText: district chips carry the measure pictogram (bed = เตียง, hospital = แห่ง), the status is a pin + number, legend items are a symbol + 1–2 words; sentences live in titles and accessible names
mapContract.water: light water --basemap-water #CFDDE7 (basemap-only, 1.22:1 from the ground) with the water-shore line --basemap-shore #B2C7D6 above the district fill; dark keeps surface.blueTint #18333E (0.3.4, owner “ใน light theme ทำให้ทะเล/water body ดูเหมือนน้ำมากกว่านี้ … แต่ยัง clean and quiet”); the coast line, district outlines and legend separate the sea from low li.supply classes, never the water hue alone
